description.text:
Coming soon to Churchil Place…

Mouth – Churchill Place is located opposite Starbucks, Birley’s Cafe and Ted’s Grooming Room, all of which are hugely popular within the Churchill Place mall.

Mouth, Churchill Place will have three main core facets, including dental and facial aesthetics treatments, hygiene services and access to specialist treatments at the flagship site Mouth, South Quay.

General dental treatments will including fillings, cleaning, simple extractions and also cosmetic procedures such as whitening and veneers. Facial rejuvenation treatments, such as botox and dermal fillers will also be offered.
